name: Content publisher
description: Drafts a post from a brief with the content-writer agent, pauses for a human to edit and approve it, then publishes the approved version through the publishing platform.

content-writer.description: Given { brief, previousDraft?, feedback? } as JSON, returns the article { title, body, channel } as structured output.

publish_post.description: Publishes an approved { title, body, channel } to the publishing platform and returns the public URL.
